name: Embit
profile: A spirited fire lizard whose tail flame burns brighter when it trusts its Trainer. Found rarely near volcanic springs.

name: Pyrodra
profile: Wings of molten flame carry Pyrodra across mountain peaks. Its searing breath can melt solid granite boulders.

name: Bubblix
profile: An amphibious water Ganjuko that stores pressurized spring water inside its shell to jet across rivers.

name: Leviatide
profile: Ruler of deep ocean currents. A single sweep of Leviatide's massive tailfin summons crashing tidal waves.

name: Florabit
profile: Born from ancient forest seeds, Florabit absorbs sunlight through its cap to release soothing healing spores.

name: Elderoak
profile: An ancient forest guardian whose bark is harder than forged iron. Whole woodland ecosystems shelter in its boughs.

name: Bunspark
profile: Static electricity crackles in its striped fur as it bounds at lightning speed through Kaze Trail's meadows.

name: Galewing
profile: A sharp-eyed sky Ganjuko that rides warm thermals above Wakaba Town searching for shiny pebbles.

name: Zephyrhawk
profile: Master of the upper winds. Zephyrhawk dives at supersonic speeds to strike before foes can even blink.

name: Buzzvolt
profile: Its metallic wings hum at a resonant frequency that discharges paralyzing bio-electric jolts.

name: Pebblor
profile: A sturdy mineral Ganjuko that snacks on iron ore around Kurogane Town to reinforce its rocky shell.

name: Titanite
profile: Forged under deep tectonic pressure, Titanite's seismic slams can split a mountain ridge in two.

name: Pyroclysm
profile: The final form of Embit. Pyroclysm commands atmospheric heatwaves capable of vaporizing incoming storm clouds.

name: Oceanlord
profile: The towering monarch of the deepest abyss. Oceanlord manipulates vortexes and ocean trenches with godlike ease.

name: Yggdrasylph
profile: Revered as an earthly avatar of life. Its blossoming petals restore vitality to blighted forests wherever it walks.

name: Raibunny
profile: Lightning discharges from its ears with thunderous cracks. It outruns squalls effortlessly across open plains.

name: Megavolt
profile: Fitted with twin tungsten stingers that deliver 50,000 volts in a split second. A terrifically aggressive fighter.

name: Geocore
profile: Said to dwell near the planet's molten core. Its footsteps cause minor tremors felt miles away.

name: Tideclaw
profile: Inhabits the shallow reefs of Zephyr Coast. Its heavy pincers can snap thick fishing line effortlessly.

name: Crushcean
profile: Encased in an iron-hard carapace that reflects incoming physical blows. A relentless shoreline guardian.

name: Serpente
profile: Glides smoothly across coastal shoals. Its fangs drip with sea venom that slows prey down.

name: Shadowkit
profile: Stealthily navigates shadows in Obsidian Caverns. Its luminous eyes can see in total pitch black.

name: Grimmfang
profile: Strikes like a phantom from the pitch black. Opponents only notice Grimmfang after they have been struck.

name: Spookid
profile: Lures lost travelers deeper into the Obsidian Mines with a swaying hypnotic blue flame.

name: Spectrolord
profile: A spectral sovereign cloaked in midnight mist. It feeds on negative emotions and drains life essence.

name: Astrakin
profile: Revered in ancient mythology. Starlight gathers on its spiraled horn to unleash radiant bursts of astral energy.

name: Celestiknight
profile: Wings woven from stellar dust allow Celestiknight to soar through the night stratosphere with magnificent grace.

name: Ursabrawl
profile: Possesses devastating physical punching strength. It snaps sturdy trees with one swing to mark its territory.

name: Solaris
profile: The mythical solar guardian said to have brought light to the world. A solitary creature of immense grace and heat.

name: Terramonarch
profile: The ancient subterranean king sleeping beneath Kurogane Mountain. Its awakening shifts regional coastlines.

name: Hydrofinfang

name: Hydrofinis
